transcript.text: Good morning. I'd like to get our routine weekly logistics review started so we can settle the temperature-controlled bay schedule for this week. As we all know, we have one temperature-controlled storage bay available across two windows: Tuesday 0600 through Wednesday 1800, and Thursday 1200 through Friday 1800. Both medical supplies and avionics batteries are scheduled for receipt and need that bay. Before we finalize anything, I'll need the written assignment, transfer record, and handling instruction from each of you for your respective loads. Let's hear from both of you -- what are your requirements and preferred windows?
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: I confirmed with the clinic warehouse this morning that the medical shipment arrives Tuesday at 0600 and must remain in temperature-controlled storage through Wednesday at 1800. The receiving manifest has not yet been added to the battalion storage schedule. The clinic also requires a temperature log every 4 hours during that window.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: I confirmed with the battery technician that the avionics battery shipment is scheduled for the Thursday window, from Thursday 1200 through Friday 1800, and requires a charge-status verification at Thursday 1200 before storage. The technician's note is still being filed with the signal section rather than the battalion schedule, so I'll make sure it gets added to the battalion storage schedule along with the written assignment, transfer record, and handling instruction.
transcript.speaker: A3

Provide written assignment, transfer record, and handling instruction for avionics batteries, and ensure the technician's note is added to the battalion storage schedule before the load is accepted.
Maintain a temperature log every 4 hours for the medical supplies during the Tuesday 0600 through Wednesday 1800 window.
Ensure charge-status verification is conducted at Thursday 1200 before the avionics batteries are placed into storage.
Publish the final storage schedule reflecting both assignments after all documentation is received.
